steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the package name com.aadhaarcardmaker.app and app name Aadhaar Card Maker.

steps.title: Configure Build Tools & Gradle
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with proper Android SDK (34), Java 8 compatibility, and dependencies.

steps.title: Setup Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure the manifest with storage permissions, appropriate theme selection, and MainActivity entry point.

steps.title: Create Card Background Vector
steps.description: Design an XML drawable border representing an elegant card layout with rounded corners and high quality styling.

steps.title: Create User Avatar Placeholder
steps.description: Create a vector or shape drawable representation for user photo placeholder before selection.

steps.title: Design App Interface Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml consisting of dual sections: a comprehensive input form and an interactive double-sided Aadhaar card template preview.

steps.title: Initialize UI Elements in Java
steps.description: Bind layout components, including input fields, buttons, preview views, and text placeholders inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Formatting & Validation
steps.description: Add dynamic formatting and auto-spacing for the 12-digit Aadhaar card number input field, and a user-friendly DOB picker dialog.

steps.title: Implement Image Selection API
steps.description: Add secure local Gallery image picker functionality to dynamically replace the Aadhaar template's profile photo.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Card Drawing
steps.description: Draw custom graphics including a simulated barcode dynamically onto the Aadhaar template in real-time.

steps.title: Develop Image Export & Save Engine
steps.description: Create custom logic using Android MediaStore to convert the compiled card layouts into a high-quality JPEG and export it directly to the gallery.

steps.title: Building Aadhaar Card Maker
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final APK package with fully functional native components.
